title: Session-start hook links an app-created worktree to the clone's shared target dir
goal: scripts/susi-worktree.sh links a new worktree's target/ to the primary checkout's, and with a path-independent cargo config (T-CLAUDECHARMINGCURIE-5) that makes a fresh worktree's first build 78 s / 81 crates instead of 698 s / 716. But most agent sessions here are created by the desktop app, not that script (this session's own worktree has a private 9 GB target/), so they get none of it. scripts/link-shared-target.sh does the same link idempotently - never in the primary checkout, never over a target/ that already holds a build, an empty leftover dir is replaced, SUSI_PRIVATE_TARGET=1 opts out, it never fails its caller - and workflow-session-start.sh (the SessionStart hook Claude, Codex and Devin all run) calls it first. Cost: cargo's build-directory lock means two sessions compiling at once wait for each other; with most units already built the compile phases are short, and the opt-out exists.
